# ADR-3106: A09: Prefer canary detections for control family 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Silent detection failures go unnoticed.

## Decision

Detection owners SHOULD prefer canary detections for control family 10 (A09-10) when validating pipeline health.

## Consequences

Canary misses page pipeline owners.
